'''Shelter Town''' (Japanese: '''コマコタウン''' ''Komako Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in the snowy northern part of the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]]. It is located near [[Snowpoint City]] and it was featured in ''[[DP125|Battling a Cute Drama!]]''.

After leaving [[Sandalstraw Town]], {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrived in Shelter Town through a mountain tunnel and stopped by the local [[Pokémon Center]], where they met [[Marilyn]], a {{pkmn|Trainer}} obsessed with cuteness. Upon seeing [[Dawn's Buneary]], Marilyn challenged {{an|Dawn}} to a {{pkmn|battle}}, and the two faced off in the Pokémon Center's battlefield.

While battling Dawn, Marilyn had her {{p|Cherubi}} acting as if it was in pain so as to add drama to the battle. {{an|Brock}}, who was [[Battle judge|refereeing]] the match, became irritated by this and told her to take the battle seriously. Marilyn did and eventually defeated Dawn. After that, Brock asked Marilyn if she would like to have a battle with him. Having noticed that Marilyn would look down on {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} failing to meet her criteria for cuteness, Brock wanted to teach her about inner beauty through a battle.

Marilyn agreed to battle Brock and, after witnessing how [[Brock's Sudowoodo]] and {{TP|Brock|Croagunk}} could be valiant regardless of their looks, understood what Brock was telling her and sent out a {{p|Shellder}} to face off against his {{TP|Brock|Happiny}}. The battle was interrupted by {{TRT}}, who wanted to steal Marilyn's cute-looking Pokémon and give them to {{an|Giovanni}}. However, Shellder and Happiny combined their strength to send them blasting off.

Dawn's [[mother]], [[Johanna]], also sent a package to her and the others through [[Nurse Joy]] containing winter clothing.

==Trivia==
* Shelter Town appears to be a reference to {{DL|Sinnoh Route 216|Snowbound Lodge|the shelter}} found on {{rt|216|Sinnoh}}.
